pairs.original: Hey girl, go on now.
pairs.simlish: Hee gurn, kuwohm dowm.

pairs.original: You know you got ev'rybody lookin'.
pairs.simlish: Yenna wanna ku ibby bonna locky.

pairs.original: Got a little boom in my big truck,
pairs.simlish: Comma livva boom an' I picked her,

pairs.original: Gonna open up my doors and turn it up,
pairs.simlish: Gobba uba nera doo na turnip nerb,

pairs.original: Gonna stomp my boots in the Georgia mud,
pairs.simlish: Give a stahm big noops ibba jer jimmup,

pairs.original: Gonna watch you make me fall in love.
pairs.simlish: Give a wahn choot need me fovva luv.

pairs.original: Get up on the hood o' my daddy's tractor,
pairs.simlish: Git opp una hoo, ah ma dee dee ep,

pairs.original: Up on the toolbox — it don't matter —
pairs.simlish: Dit dock una too big, eebu mat,

pairs.original: Down on the tailgate — girl, I can't wait
pairs.simlish: Ur dune on a taykay — gurn, I can't way

pairs.original: To watch you do your thing!
pairs.simlish: Tu watch you doodah thing!

pairs.original: Shake it for the young bucks sittin' in the honky-tonks,
pairs.simlish: Sheeky fawa yomp pig simpit on th' hurky-durks,

pairs.original: For the rednecks rockin' 'til the break of dawn,
pairs.simlish: Fawa rim big spricky illa back be dirk,

pairs.original: The DJ spinnin' that country song,
pairs.simlish: Fawa GJ snippy-snack crumply snurf,

pairs.original: C'mon, c'mon, c'mon!
pairs.simlish: Sum on, sum on, sum on!

pairs.original: Shake it for the birds, shake it for the bees,
pairs.simlish: Sheeky fawa burrs, sheeky fawa bwees,

pairs.original: Shake it for the catfish swimmin' down deep in the creek,
pairs.simlish: Sheeky fawa coo flay simma fown deepin' th' kreeze,

pairs.original: For the crickets an' the critters an' the squirrels,
pairs.simlish: Fawa crickles an' th' griffin an' th' squirn,

pairs.simlish: Sheeky dawa moom, sheeky fabby gurn!

pairs.original: That got it in her blood to get a little wild.

pairs.original: Ponytail and a pretty smile,
pairs.simlish: Noobie day in a pibbly smurf,

pairs.original: Rope me in from a country mile.
pairs.simlish: Roop me yib puma crumply mine.

pairs.original: So come on over here and get in my arms,
pairs.simlish: Sakeeya neeya heeya an' godd nees arns,

pairs.original: Spin me around this big old barn,
pairs.simlish: Spineeya rose it bin fo' blarn,

pairs.original: Tangle me up like gramma's yarn.

pairs.simlish: An' th' wee noobie hill uber me foo pwye.

pairs.original: Yeah, move like the river flows.
pairs.simlish: Jibs, moo mocha ribby foo.

pairs.original: Feel the kick drum down deep in your toes.

pairs.original: All I wanna do is get to holdin' you,
pairs.simlish: Hobiwabanusi gobba hurn a boose,

pairs.original: an' get to knowin' you, an' get to showin' you
pairs.simlish: A-gobba noova boose, a-gibba shoova goo,

pairs.original: an' get to lovin' you, 'fore the night is through.
pairs.simlish: Ya' give a lurvly vu, b'fore da nye biz through,
